name: Straight knee calf stretch
target: Upper calf muscle called gastrocnemius
steps: Place your hands on the support. Step one foot back.
Keep the back heel down and the back knee straight.
Bend the front knee and move your body forwards.
cue: Point both feet forwards. Do not lock the back knee.
draw: Side view. Show the straight back knee, low heel, and forward arrow.
unique: Straight knee places more stretch on the upper calf.
label: 01 Straight knee calf stretch

app_instruction.en: Step the named leg back, keep that knee straight without locking it, and its heel down. Bend the front knee gently. Use a stable wall or railing if needed.
app_instruction.es: Lleva atrás la pierna indicada, con la rodilla extendida sin bloquearla y el talón apoyado. Flexiona suavemente la rodilla delantera. Usa una pared o barandilla firme si lo necesitas.
app_instruction.zh-Hans: 指定侧腿向后迈，膝盖自然伸直但不锁死，脚跟保持着地。前侧膝盖轻轻弯曲，需要时可扶稳墙壁或栏杆。

name: Bent knee calf stretch
target: Deep calf muscle called soleus
steps: Place one foot behind the other. Hold the support.
Keep the back heel down and bend both knees.
Lower your hips a little until the lower calf stretches.
cue: Keep your weight centred. Use a small movement.
draw: Side view. Show both knees bent and the back heel on the ground.
unique: Bent knee reduces upper calf tension and gives a different calf stretch.
label: 02 Bent knee calf stretch

app_instruction.en: Step the named leg back, keep its heel down, and soften both knees. Stay upright and use a stable wall or railing if you need balance.
app_instruction.es: Lleva atrás la pierna indicada, mantén el talón apoyado y flexiona suavemente ambas rodillas. Mantente erguido y usa una pared o barandilla firme si necesitas equilibrio.
app_instruction.zh-Hans: 指定侧腿向后迈，脚跟保持着地，双膝自然微屈。身体保持挺直，需要时可扶稳墙壁或栏杆。

name: Standing shin stretch
target: Front of the shin and ankle
steps: Hold the support. Put most of your weight on one foot.
Place the top of the other toes on the ground just behind you.
Keep light toe contact and move that leg forwards a little.
cue: Keep almost all weight on the standing leg. Do not press into the toe joints.
draw: Side view with a foot close view. Show light contact on the top of the toes.
unique: Ankle points down to stretch the front of the lower leg.
source_title: Verywell Fit shin stretch reviewed by a physical therapist
label: 03 Standing shin stretch

name: Standing front thigh stretch
target: Front thigh muscles called quadriceps
steps: Hold the support. Bend one knee behind you.
Hold that ankle and bring the heel towards your buttock.
Keep your knees close and your body upright.
cue: Keep the bent knee below your hip. Do not pull the leg out to the side.
draw: Side view. Show one hand on the support and the other on the ankle.
unique: Main action is knee bending with the thigh beside the body.
label: 04 Standing front thigh stretch

app_instruction.en: Hold a stable wall or railing. Bend the named knee and gently bring that heel toward your bottom, keeping knees close. Skip if support is unavailable or balance feels difficult.
app_instruction.es: Sujétate a una pared o barandilla firme. Flexiona la rodilla indicada y acerca suavemente el talón al glúteo, manteniendo las rodillas juntas. Omite el movimiento si no tienes apoyo o te cuesta mantener el equilibrio.
app_instruction.zh-Hans: 扶稳墙壁或栏杆，弯曲指定侧膝盖，轻轻将脚跟靠近臀部，双膝保持靠近。没有稳固支撑或难以保持平衡时，请跳过。

name: Heel forward hamstring stretch
target: Back of the thigh
steps: Place one heel a short step in front of you.
Bend the back knee. Keep the front knee almost straight.
Move your hips back and lean forwards from the hips.
cue: Keep your back long. Rest your hands on the bent thigh.
draw: Side view. Show the front heel down and an arrow at the hip hinge.
unique: Single straight leg stretch for the back of the thigh.
label: 05 Heel forward hamstring stretch

app_instruction.en: Place the named heel a short step forward with toes up. Bend the other knee and hinge gently at the hips with a long back; rest hands on the bent thigh.
app_instruction.es: Adelanta un poco el talón del lado indicado y eleva los dedos. Flexiona la otra rodilla e inclínate suavemente desde las caderas, con la espalda alargada y las manos sobre el muslo flexionado.
app_instruction.zh-Hans: 将指定侧脚跟向前迈一小步，脚尖抬起。另一侧膝盖微屈，背部自然伸展，从髋部轻轻前倾，双手扶在屈膝侧大腿上。

name: Standing front hip stretch
target: Front hip muscles called hip flexors
steps: Take a short split stance. Raise the back heel.
Bend both knees a little and tighten the back buttock.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and move your hips forwards.
cue: Keep your chest above your hips. Do not arch your lower back.
draw: Side view. Show the split stance and a short forward pelvis arrow.
unique: Hip moves behind the body while the back knee stays only slightly bent.
source_title: Free Exercise DB Standing Hip Flexors
label: 06 Standing front hip stretch

name: Side lunge inner thigh stretch
target: Inner thigh muscles called adductors
steps: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Bend one knee and move your hips towards that side.
Keep the other leg long and both feet on the ground.
cue: Keep the bent knee in line with its toes.
draw: Front view. Show one bent knee, one long leg, and a sideways pelvis arrow.
unique: Hip moves sideways over a straight opposite leg.
label: 07 Side lunge inner thigh stretch

app_instruction.en: Stand wide and bend one knee while keeping the other leg long. Sit your hips back, keep feet planted and hold gentle tension along the inner thigh.
app_instruction.zh-Hans: 双脚分开，屈一侧膝盖，另一腿伸长。臀部向后移，双脚贴地，保持大腿内侧轻柔的牵拉感。
app_instruction.es: Separa los pies y flexiona una rodilla mientras la otra pierna queda larga. Lleva las caderas atrás, mantén los pies apoyados y siente una tensión suave en la cara interna del muslo.

name: Crossed leg outer hip stretch
target: Muscles at the outside of the hip
steps: Stand with your right side near a support. Hold it.
Cross your left foot in front of your right foot.
Move your right hip towards the support and lean your chest slightly left.
cue: Feel the outer hip. Do not twist your knees. Change sides.
draw: Front view. Show crossed ankles and opposite arrows for hip and chest.
unique: Standing hip adduction with a side shift. Target is outer hip muscle, not IT band length.
label: 08 Crossed leg outer hip stretch

name: Supported squat stretch
target: Hips groin and ankles together
steps: Hold the rail. Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips.
Bend both knees and lower into a comfortable squat.
Keep your heels down and use your arms to control the depth.
cue: Keep knees in line with toes. Stop at a comfortable depth.
draw: Front three quarter view. Show both hands on the rail and heels down.
unique: Both hips and ankles bend together in a supported squat.
label: 09 Supported squat stretch

name: Overhead side bend
target: Side of the trunk
steps: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Raise one arm above your head.
Bend your trunk gently away from the raised arm.
cue: Keep weight on both feet. Keep your chest facing forwards.
draw: Front view. Show one arm overhead and a short side bend arrow.
unique: Trunk bends sideways with both feet parallel.
source_title: Free Exercise DB Standing Lateral Stretch
label: 10 Overhead side bend

name: Supported back and shoulder stretch
target: Broad back muscles called lats and shoulders
equipment: Fixed rail or stable table at about waist height
steps: Put both hands on the support and step back.
Bend your knees slightly and move your hips backwards.
Lower your chest between your arms while you keep your back long.
cue: Keep your ribs from dropping into a large back arch.
draw: Side view. Show a hip hinge, long arms, and the fixed rail or stable table.
unique: Arms stay forward and overhead relative to the trunk.
label: 11 Supported back and shoulder stretch

app_instruction.en: Place both hands on a fixed, sturdy surface around waist height. Step back and hinge at your hips, keeping your back long. Skip if suitable support is unavailable.
app_instruction.es: Apoya las manos en una superficie fija y firme a la altura de la cintura. Da un paso atrás e inclínate desde las caderas, manteniendo la espalda alargada. Omítelo si no tienes un apoyo adecuado.
app_instruction.zh-Hans: 双手放在腰部高度的固定稳固台面上，向后退，从髋部前倾，背部保持伸展。没有合适支撑时请跳过。

name: Rounded upper back reach
target: Muscles between the shoulder blades
steps: Join your hands in front of your chest.
Turn your palms away and reach forwards.
Let your shoulder blades move apart as your upper back rounds gently.
cue: Keep your shoulders low. Do not pull on your neck.
draw: Side three quarter view. Show hands forward and arrows between shoulder blades.
unique: Shoulder blades spread apart instead of the arms moving overhead.
source_title: Free Exercise DB Upper Back Stretch
label: 12 Rounded upper back reach

app_instruction.en: Reach both arms forward with hands together. Gently round your upper back and let your shoulder blades move apart; keep your knees soft.
app_instruction.es: Extiende los brazos al frente con las manos juntas. Redondea suavemente la espalda alta y separa los omóplatos; mantén las rodillas relajadas.
app_instruction.zh-Hans: 双手合拢向前伸，轻轻拱起上背，让肩胛骨向两侧展开，膝盖保持微屈。

name: Arm across chest stretch
target: Back of the shoulder
steps: Bring one arm across your chest.
Use the other hand to support the upper arm above the elbow.
Draw the arm gently towards your chest.
cue: Keep the stretching shoulder down.
draw: Front view. Show a low shoulder and the hand above the opposite elbow.
unique: Upper arm moves across the body to stretch the back shoulder.
source_title: University of Washington upper body stretches
label: 13 Arm across chest stretch

app_instruction.en: Stand with both feet grounded. Bring the named arm across your chest and gently support it above or below the elbow; keep the shoulder relaxed.
app_instruction.es: Apoya ambos pies. Cruza el brazo indicado por delante del pecho y sujétalo suavemente por encima o debajo del codo, manteniendo el hombro relajado.
app_instruction.zh-Hans: 双脚站稳，将指定侧手臂横放于胸前，另一只手轻扶肘部上方或下方，肩膀保持放松。

name: Overhead upper arm stretch
target: Back upper arm muscle called triceps
steps: Raise one arm and bend the elbow.
Let that hand rest behind your head.
Use the other hand to guide the raised elbow gently backwards.
cue: Keep your ribs down. Keep pressure off your head.
draw: Back three quarter view. Show the bent elbow and hand behind the head.
unique: Elbow bends while the upper arm stays overhead.
source_title: University of Washington upper body stretches
label: 14 Overhead upper arm stretch

app_instruction.en: Raise one arm and bend the elbow so your hand rests behind your head. Rest the other hand above that elbow and apply only gentle pressure; keep your ribs relaxed.
app_instruction.es: Eleva un brazo y dobla el codo, dejando la mano detrás de la cabeza. Apoya la otra mano por encima del codo y presiona suavemente, sin sacar las costillas.
app_instruction.zh-Hans: 一只手臂举过头顶并屈肘，手放在头后；另一只手轻扶肘部上方，不要用力拉，肋骨保持放松。

name: Chest stretch at a post
target: Chest and front shoulder
equipment: Wide post wall edge or door frame
steps: Place one forearm on the support. Keep the elbow at or below shoulder height.
Take a small step forwards.
Turn your chest slightly away until the chest stretches.
cue: Keep the shoulder low. Stop if the front of the shoulder pinches.
draw: Top three quarter view. Show bent elbow on the post and a small turn arrow.
unique: Shoulder opens with a bent elbow and an arm supported to the side.
source_title: University of Washington upper body stretches
label: 15 Chest stretch at a post

app_instruction.en: Place one forearm against a wall with the elbow at shoulder height. Turn your chest gently away until you feel a mild stretch. Keep the shoulder relaxed; do not force the turn.
app_instruction.es: Apoya un antebrazo en la pared con el codo a la altura del hombro. Gira suavemente el pecho en sentido contrario hasta notar una tensión leve. Relaja el hombro y no fuerces el giro.
app_instruction.zh-Hans: 一侧前臂贴墙，肘部与肩同高，胸口轻轻转向另一侧，感受温和拉伸。肩膀放松，不要强扭。

name: Hands behind biceps stretch
target: Front upper arm muscles called biceps
steps: Join your hands behind your hips.
Straighten your elbows without locking them.
Move your hands a small distance away from your back.
cue: Keep your chest upright and shoulders low. Use only a small lift.
draw: Side view. Show straight elbows and a short arrow behind the hips.
unique: Straight elbows combine with arms behind the body.
source_title: Free Exercise DB Standing Biceps Stretch
label: 16 Hands behind biceps stretch

name: Side neck stretch
target: Side of the neck and upper shoulder
steps: Stand tall and relax both shoulders.
Tilt one ear towards the same side shoulder.
Stop when you feel a light stretch on the other side.
cue: Do not lift the shoulder or pull your head with a hand.
draw: Front view. Show a level shoulder line and a small head tilt arrow.
unique: Head tilts sideways without turning.
label: 17 Side neck stretch

name: Diagonal neck stretch
target: Back corner of the neck near the shoulder blade
steps: Relax your shoulders and turn your head about halfway to one side.
Lower your chin towards that armpit.
Hold a light stretch at the opposite back corner of your neck.
cue: Use your neck muscles only. Do not pull on your head.
draw: Front three quarter view. Use separate turn and downward arrows.
unique: Head turns and bends diagonally, unlike a pure side tilt.
label: 18 Diagonal neck stretch

name: Back neck stretch
target: Back of the neck
steps: Stand tall with relaxed shoulders.
Lower your chin gently towards your chest.
Keep your head facing straight forwards as it lowers.
cue: Use a small range. Keep your hands off your head.
draw: Side view. Show a small forward head nod arrow.
unique: Neck bends forwards without a side tilt or turn.
label: 19 Back neck stretch

name: Neck turn stretch
target: Neck rotation
steps: Keep your shoulders facing forwards.
Turn your head slowly to look over one shoulder.
Stop before you feel pain or strain.
cue: Keep your chin level. Do not tip your head backwards.
draw: Front three quarter view. Show fixed shoulders and a head turn arrow.
unique: Head rotates with the chin level.
label: 20 Neck turn stretch

name: Palm up wrist stretch
target: Inner forearm muscles that bend the wrist
steps: Reach one arm forwards with the palm up.
Let the fingers point towards the ground.
Use the other hand on the palm to bend the wrist gently back.
cue: Keep a small bend in the elbow. Do not pull individual fingers.
draw: Arm close view. Clearly show palm up and fingers pointing down.
unique: Wrist extends with the palm up.
dose: 15 to 20 seconds per side; 1 or 2 rounds
label: 21 Palm up wrist stretch

name: Palm down wrist stretch
target: Outer forearm muscles that straighten the wrist
steps: Reach one arm forwards with the palm down.
Let the hand bend down at the wrist.
Place the other hand on the back of that hand and guide it towards you.
cue: Keep the elbow slightly bent and fingers relaxed.
draw: Arm close view. Clearly show palm down and a wrist bend arrow.
unique: Wrist flexes with the palm down.
dose: 15 to 20 seconds per side; 1 or 2 rounds
label: 22 Palm down wrist stretch

name: Palm up forearm turn
target: Forearm muscles used to turn the palm down
steps: Bend one elbow to a right angle and keep it next to your ribs.
Turn that palm upwards.
Support the wrist with the other hand and add a very small turn.
cue: Keep the wrist straight. Keep the elbow next to your body.
draw: Front close view. Show the elbow against the ribs and a rotation arrow.
unique: Forearm rotates towards palm up. The wrist does not bend.
source_title: Cambridge University Hospitals wrist and forearm stretches
label: 23 Palm up forearm turn

name: Palm down forearm turn
target: Forearm muscles used to turn the palm up
steps: Bend one elbow to a right angle and keep it next to your ribs.
Turn that palm downwards.
Support the wrist with the other hand and add a very small turn.
cue: Keep the shoulder still and the wrist straight.
draw: Front close view. Show the palm turning down around the forearm axis.
unique: Forearm rotates in the opposite direction to the palm up turn.
source_title: Cambridge University Hospitals wrist and forearm stretches
label: 24 Palm down forearm turn

name: Thumb web stretch
target: Soft tissue between the thumb and index finger
steps: Relax one hand and open the thumb away from the index finger.
Use your other hand to support the thumb near its base.
Open the web space gently without bending the thumb joints backwards.
cue: Use light pressure near the base. Do not pull the thumb tip.
draw: Palm close view. Show a small opening arrow across the thumb web.
unique: Thumb moves away from the index finger while the wrist stays still.
dose: 3 to 5 seconds per side; repeat 3 times
label: 25 Thumb web stretch

name: Finger straightening stretch
target: Palm and finger flexor tissues
steps: Hold one hand in front of you with its wrist straight.
Open your fingers from a relaxed curl.
Support them with the other hand and gently guide them straight.
cue: Stop when fingers line up with the back of the hand. Do not bend them backwards.
draw: Hand close view. Show curled and straight positions with a short arrow.
unique: Finger joints straighten while the wrist stays neutral.
source_title: Royal National Orthopaedic Hospital hand stretches
label: 26 Finger straightening stretch

name: Shoulder turn with a towel behind the back
target: Shoulder internal rotation
steps: Hold a towel above one shoulder. Catch the lower end behind your waist.
Use the top hand to lift the towel gently.
Let the lower hand slide a little higher on your back.
cue: Keep the lower shoulder relaxed. Use a small pain free range.
draw: Back view. Show both towel ends and a short upward arrow at the lower hand.
unique: Lower shoulder rotates inward with the elbow behind the body.
dose: 5 to 10 seconds per side; repeat 2 times
label: 27 Shoulder turn with a towel behind the back

name: Outward shoulder turn with a stick
target: Shoulder external rotation
equipment: Light straight stick and small towel
steps: Bend both elbows to right angles and hold the stick across your waist.
Place the towel between the stretching elbow and your ribs.
Use the other arm to move that hand outwards while its elbow stays at your side.
cue: Keep your chest still and wrist straight. Do not force the shoulder.
draw: Front view. Show one elbow held at the ribs and a sideways hand arrow.
unique: Upper arm rotates outward while its elbow remains beside the trunk.
dose: 5 to 10 seconds per side; repeat 2 times
label: 28 Outward shoulder turn with a stick

name: Single knee to chest
target: Buttock and lower back
steps: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Hold behind one thigh and bring that knee towards your chest.
Keep your head relaxed and the other foot on the mat.
cue: Hold the thigh instead of pulling on the kneecap.
draw: Side view. Show one thigh held close and the other foot on the mat.
unique: One hip bends towards the chest without rotation.
source_title: Free Exercise DB One Knee To Chest
label: 29 Single knee to chest

name: Lying figure four
target: Buttock and outer hip
steps: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Rest one ankle on the opposite thigh above the knee.
Hold behind the lower thigh and bring it towards your chest.
cue: Keep the crossed foot active. Do not press on the crossed knee.
draw: Front three quarter view. Show the four shape and hands behind the lower thigh.
unique: One hip rotates out while the opposite leg brings it closer.
label: 30 Lying figure four

app_instruction.en: Lie on your back, cross one ankle over the opposite thigh, and draw your legs gently toward your chest.
app_instruction.es: Túmbate boca arriba, cruza un tobillo sobre el muslo contrario y acerca suavemente las piernas al pecho.
app_instruction.zh-Hans: 仰卧，将一侧脚踝搭在另一侧大腿上，再轻轻把双腿拉向胸前。

name: Lying inward hip turn
target: Hip internal rotation
steps: Lie on your back with one leg straight.
Bend the other knee and place its foot slightly outside that hip.
Let the bent knee move inwards a small distance while your pelvis stays still.
cue: Keep the foot planted. Stop if the front of the hip or knee pinches.
draw: Top view. Show a fixed pelvis and an inward knee arrow.
unique: Hip rotates inward. No trunk twist or crossed ankle is used.
label: 31 Lying inward hip turn

name: Butterfly stretch
target: Inner thighs with the hips turned out
steps: Sit upright and put the soles of your feet together.
Hold your ankles and let both knees move apart.
Stay tall until you feel a gentle inner thigh stretch.
cue: Support the knees with cushions if needed. Do not push them down.
draw: Front view. Show joined soles and relaxed knees open to the sides.
unique: Bent knees and joined soles place both hips in external rotation.
label: 32 Butterfly stretch

app_instruction.en: Sit tall with the soles of your feet together. Let your knees relax outward without pushing them down.
app_instruction.es: Siéntate con la espalda erguida y las plantas de los pies juntas. Deja que las rodillas se abran sin empujarlas.
app_instruction.zh-Hans: 坐直并让双脚脚掌相对，放松膝盖向两侧打开，不要用手向下压。

name: Wide knee frog stretch
target: Inner thighs with the hips bent
equipment: Mat or folded towels under the knees
steps: Start on your hands and knees.
Move the knees a little wider and keep the ankles behind the knees.
Move your hips backwards slightly until the inner thighs stretch.
cue: Keep the movement small. Do not force your knees wider.
draw: Top three quarter view. Show separated knees and shins behind them.
unique: Knees bear light weight and stay apart. Feet do not join as in butterfly.
label: 33 Wide knee frog stretch

name: Long inner thigh rock back
target: Inner thigh with one knee straight
steps: Start on your hands and knees.
Extend one leg out to the side with that foot on the floor.
Keep your back long and move your hips towards the bent leg heel.
cue: Keep the long leg still. Stop before your lower back rounds.
draw: Front three quarter view. Show one knee down, one leg sideways, and a back arrow.
unique: Hip bends backwards over a straight side leg instead of shifting sideways.
dose: Move slowly 5 times per side; pause 3 seconds
label: 34 Long inner thigh rock back

name: Seated wide leg forward stretch
target: Inner thighs and back thighs together
equipment: Mat and optional folded towel to sit on
steps: Sit with your legs in a comfortable V shape.
Keep a small bend in both knees.
Place your hands in front and lean forwards from your hips.
cue: Use a modest leg width. Keep your spine long.
draw: Front three quarter view. Show the V shape and a small forward hip hinge.
unique: Both straight legs are apart while the hips bend forwards.
label: 35 Seated wide leg forward stretch

app_instruction.en: Sit with legs comfortably apart and knees soft. Hinge gently forward from your hips with a long back, resting hands on the floor in front. Do not force your chest down.
app_instruction.zh-Hans: 坐下，双腿舒适地分开，膝盖放松。从髋部轻轻向前俯身，背部舒展，双手放在身前地面，不要强压胸口向下。
app_instruction.es: Siéntate con las piernas separadas cómodamente y las rodillas relajadas. Inclínate suavemente desde las caderas con la espalda larga y apoya las manos delante. No fuerces el pecho hacia abajo.

name: Happy baby stretch
target: Inner thighs and deep hip muscles
steps: Lie on your back and bring both knees towards your chest.
Move the knees apart and hold behind the thighs or hold the feet.
Let your lower back stay heavy on the mat as your knees move towards your armpits.
cue: Keep your head down. Do not force your tailbone off the mat.
draw: Front three quarter view. Show wide bent knees and hands supporting the legs.
unique: Both hips bend deeply and open while the body lies on its back.
label: 36 Happy baby stretch

name: Kneeling front thigh and hip stretch
target: Two joint front thigh muscle called rectus femoris
equipment: Mat knee pad and optional strap
steps: Kneel on one padded knee and put the other foot in front.
Hold the back ankle, or use a strap, and draw the heel towards your buttock.
Tuck your pelvis slightly while you keep the back thigh behind your hip.
cue: Keep your chest tall. Skip this stretch if kneeling hurts.
draw: Side view. Show the front foot, padded back knee, and bent back leg.
unique: Combines a bent knee with a hip held behind the body.
source_title: Physitrack kneeling hip flexor and thigh stretch
label: 37 Kneeling front thigh and hip stretch

name: Child pose with arms relaxed
target: Lower back and back of the hips
steps: Kneel with your feet close together.
Move your buttocks towards your heels and lower your chest.
Rest your forehead on a cushion and place your arms beside your legs.
cue: Keep space for your stomach. Skip it if the knees hurt.
draw: Side view. Show hips near heels and arms beside the body.
unique: Back and hips fold while the shoulders and arms stay relaxed.
label: 38 Child pose with arms relaxed

name: Cat and cow stretch
target: Back muscles through gentle spine movement
steps: Start on your hands and knees.
Breathe out and round your back gently.
Breathe in and let your chest move forwards as your back forms a small curve.
cue: Use a small smooth range. Keep your elbows straight without locking them.
draw: Two side views. Show rounded and gently curved back positions.
unique: Alternates spine bending and extension instead of holding a folded pose.
label: 39 Cat and cow stretch

name: Low sphinx stretch
target: Front of the trunk and gentle back extension
steps: Lie on your front with elbows below or just ahead of your shoulders.
Keep your pelvis on the mat.
Press into your forearms and lift your chest gently.
cue: Look ahead and slightly down. Stop if your lower back pinches.
draw: Side view. Show forearms down, a low chest lift, and pelvis on the mat.
unique: Spine extends while the pelvis stays supported.
label: 40 Low sphinx stretch

name: Bent knee lower trunk turn
target: Lower back and side of the trunk
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet on the mat.
Keep your knees together and let both move slowly to one side.
Keep both shoulders resting on the mat.
cue: Use a small range. Return slowly before changing sides.
draw: Top view. Show paired knees moving sideways and both shoulders down.
unique: Pelvis turns while the upper trunk stays still.
dose: 10 to 20 seconds per side; 1 or 2 rounds
label: 41 Bent knee lower trunk turn

name: Side lying open book
target: Middle back and chest
equipment: Mat and pillow for your head
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and stacked. Reach both arms forwards.
Lift the top arm and turn your chest open as the arm moves behind you.
Keep the knees together and return slowly.
cue: Let the arm stay above the floor if needed. Do not force the shoulder down.
draw: Two top three quarter views. Show stacked knees and an opening arm arc.
unique: Upper trunk turns open while the pelvis stays still.
source_title: Leeds Teaching Hospitals chest and upper back exercises
label: 42 Side lying open book

name: Thread the needle stretch
target: Back shoulder and middle back
steps: Start on your hands and knees.
Slide one arm under the other arm with its palm facing up.
Lower that shoulder towards the mat as your upper back turns.
cue: Rest your head lightly. Keep weight off the neck.
draw: Front three quarter view. Show the arm passing under the chest.
unique: Upper trunk turns with the arm across the body instead of opening behind it.
label: 43 Thread the needle stretch

name: Lying full body reach
target: Front and sides of the trunk
steps: Lie on your back with your legs long.
Reach both arms overhead within a comfortable range.
Reach your heels away while your hands reach in the opposite direction.
cue: Keep your ribs low. Bend the knees if your back arches.
draw: Top view. Show small arrows away from the hands and heels.
unique: Body lengthens in opposite directions without a twist or forward bend.
label: 44 Lying full body reach

name: Sole of foot stretch
target: Plantar fascia along the arch
steps: Sit and rest one ankle across the other thigh.
Hold the heel with one hand.
Use the other hand at the base of the toes to bend them gently towards your shin.
cue: Keep the ankle near neutral. Feel the arch stretch.
draw: Foot close view. Show heel support and toes bending up at their bases.
unique: Toe bases extend to tension the sole of the foot.
label: 45 Sole of foot stretch

name: Toe downward stretch

app_instruction.en: Kneel in a split stance, gently tuck your pelvis, and keep your spine neutral as you shift forward.
